answer: Under EigenTrust, normalized, reciprocity-weighted trust propagates through transitive links, while scores decay exponentially with a fixed half-life. A vault of past ratings loses influence without sustained honest service. A freshly spawned Sybil identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality; cloning accounts creates no trusted incoming paths, so they cannot reach the consensus threshold. Even at their zenith, coordinated identities cannot harbor durable reputation without reciprocal, verified history.
